title: Tiling ribbon: Positive proof strip
topics: Greedy choices, dynamic programming and backtracking
summary: For each width x, count the ordered ways to fill a one-row ribbon using pieces of widths 1 and 3. A width of 0 has one empty arrangement. Produce the counts in input order. Return only the strictly positive values in the derived sequence, preserving their relative order and duplicates.

referenceSolutions.python:
def tilingRibbonPositiveProofStrip(readings, k):
    a=readings
    out=[]
    m=max(a,default=0)
    dp=[0]*(m+1)
    dp[0]=1
    for i in range(1,m+1): dp[i]=dp[i-1]+(dp[i-3] if i>=3 else 0)
    out=[dp[x] for x in a]
    return [x for x in out if x>0]
